create_FreezeContainer: create a FreezeContainer to freeze a PyTorch module by setting eval mode and disabling gradients
create_FreezeModule: create a FreezeModule nn.Module wrapper that freezes a PyTorch module and disables gradient computation
use_FreezeContainer_call: use FreezeContainer as a callable to forward inputs through a frozen PyTorch module
use_FreezeModule_forward: use FreezeModule forward method to pass data through a frozen module during inference
freeze_pytorch_module: freeze a PyTorch module parameters by wrapping it with FreezeModule to disable gradients and set eval mode
